page.title: Donate
page.description: Give to Transform International (Canada): support Street Business School in Burundi, Rwanda Rising, STREAMS in Malawi or Open Hands India. Tax receipts for gifts over $25.
page.heading: Give where it *grows*
page.intro: Your gift goes to local partners who turn it into businesses, school years and clean water — and the results keep growing long after.
page.formHeading: Give to where the need is greatest
page.formText: A general gift lets our partners put your donation wherever it will do the most good right now. The secure form below is run by Zeffy.
page.formInstruction: Enter your amount and click Continue. You can choose a specific program on the next step.
page.programsText: Pick a program and give through its own secure Zeffy form, so your gift goes exactly where you choose.
page.generalProgramsHeading: These programs are supported through our general donation form
page.volunteer: Lend your skills, share a campaign on Facebook, or present our work to your Rotary Club.

levels.title: Training materials and coaching
levels.text: Contributes toward training materials, coaching and participant support for Street Business School in Gitega.

levels.title: Half of one woman’s training
levels.text: Covers about half the cost of one participant’s Street Business School training in Burundi.

levels.title: One woman’s complete training
levels.text: Funds one participant’s complete Street Business School training in Burundi, from her first weekend of training to graduation day.

levels.title: Five women through the full training
levels.text: Funds five participants through all six months of Street Business School training and home coaching in Gitega.

levels.title: About 12 women through the training
levels.text: Trains about 12 participants, from the first weekend of Street Business School to graduation.

levels.title: An entire cohort of about 30 women
levels.text: Funds a whole Street Business School cohort of about 30 participants, from the first weekend of training to graduation.

levels.title: School lunch, notebooks and uniform
levels.text: Provides school lunch, notebooks and a uniform to a day student in Rwanda.

levels.title: A year of boarding school
levels.text: Provides a year of great education at boarding school for a top-performing student from one of the poorest families.

levels.title: A university living stipend
levels.text: Gives a living stipend to a scholarship winner in university.

levels.title: Learn a trade
levels.text: Provides sewing tools, materials and instruction for a woman learning to earn an income in rural Bihar.

taxReceipt: Donations of more than $25 receive an official Canadian tax receipt.
zeffyNote: We use Zeffy, a donation platform that is free for charities, so 100% of your gift goes to the work. At checkout Zeffy may invite you to leave them an optional tip; it is never required.
zeffyShortNote: Our donation platform, Zeffy, is free for charities, so 100% of your gift goes to the work.
eTransfer: Prefer e-Transfer? Send it to donations@transforminternational.ca and include your name and mailing address for your tax receipt.
legacy: Planning a gift in your will, or naming us as the beneficiary of an RRSP, RRIF or TFSA? Our CEO, Carl Monk, would be glad to talk it through with you.

securities.heading: Gifts of stock and *securities*
text: You can give publicly traded shares or other securities directly to Transform International (Canada) through CanadaHelps, without selling them first.
CanadaHelps handles the transfer and sends your official tax receipt.
points: To be receipted for this year, start the transfer by December 15.
Please check with your accountant or financial advisor about your own tax situation.
